Review complete — verdict: **approve, no changes requested**.

**What I checked** (diff via `gh pr diff 1201` plus surrounding code at head `e7f6553`):

- **Accessibility** — the path line is a real `<button type="button">` with an i18n `aria-label`; no `outline-none` was added, so the default focus ring and keyboard activation are intact.
- **Styling consistency** — `underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-2 hover:opacity-80` exactly matches the shrink link in `CheckoutModePill.svelte`, while keeping the line's prior `text-xs text-muted-foreground` look and the trigger's `cursor-copy` affordance.
- **Truncation + title** — `block w-full truncate` with `title={workspacePath}` preserved inside the `w-56` card.
- **Card stays open** — `copyRepoPath` does `stopPropagation()`/`preventDefault()` and sets `repoTooltipOpen = true`; the `TooltipRich` is `interactive` with `disableCloseOnTriggerClick`, so the existing "Copied ✓" indicator surfaces.
- **i18n** — key naming follows `workspace_progressCard_closeWorkspace_ariaLabel` convention, present in all 8 catalogs at the alphabetical position; translations read correctly.
- **No collateral changes** — trigger copy-on-click, branch tooltip, and `CheckoutModePill` untouched.

**Evidence run locally at the PR head** (CI was still pending): `pnpm vitest run src/lib/components/workspace/sidebar/__tests__/` → 21 files / 378 tests passed; `pnpm run lint` → passes including hardcoded-string and i18n-completeness checks.

**Posted** the review as a [PR comment](https://github.com/intent-hq/cloudlands-fe/pull/1201#issuecomment-5291835951) — `gh` is authenticated as the PR author, so a formal approve review isn't permitted by GitHub. It includes three non-blocking notes: redundant `max-w-full`, no `aria-live` on the "Copied" indicator (pre-existing pattern), and source-string-style tests (consistent with the file's existing convention).
